text: Runtime aux `bootstrap_entry` shall be an untyped first-native-entry shim establishing reserved context/initial packet before entering typed bootstrap with image metadata. It shall not be source callable. Native foreign code shall require an explicit checked adapter published as a conforming `smil.object.v1`; native container readers shall require a separate transport contract.
